rationale: Archive Freight Ninja as a standalone manager-level PortCo while preserving it as an active, distinct LAZ-controlled operating company. LAZ Parking stated on May 6, 2025 that it had acquired a majority interest in Freight Ninja, while Freight Ninja's current site and separate LLC terms confirm that it continues operating as its own legal identity. Freight Ninja and LAZ are therefore not duplicate companies and no canonical merge or redirect is appropriate. Argo Infrastructure Partners' directly evidenced manager-level investment is LAZ; Freight Ninja is an acquisition beneath that platform. Retain the single Argo audit period as indirect through LAZ, preserve Freight Ninja's operating and acquisition history in its archived production record, and record no Argo exit or pending transaction. LAZ's current scorecard does not yet contain a Freight Ninja milestone; that scorecard-only omission will be revalidated and handled during LAZ's later authoritative full-company research task and does not alter the Phase 1 list boundary. The approved archive overlay removes Freight Ninja from the evaluated manager-level seed list while retaining its legal and audit history in production.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Freight Ninja LLC is a Lombard, Illinois-based provider of industrial outdoor storage and managed parking for trucks, trailers, containers and commercial fleets. Established in 2022, the company provides site management, security, technology, access and operating support across a nationwide location network. LAZ Parking stated on May 6, 2025 that it had acquired a majority interest in Freight Ninja; the exact stake, retained seller or management ownership and legal closing date were not publicly disclosed. Freight Ninja's current site reports more than 65 facilities in 14 states, compared with 50 leased or managed locations, more than 300 acres and 10,000 spaces disclosed by LAZ at acquisition. Freight Ninja continues as a distinct active LLC, while Argo Infrastructure Partners' directly evidenced manager-level investment is LAZ. Freight Ninja is therefore archived from the standalone manager-level PortCo census as an acquisition beneath LAZ, with no legal merge, Argo exit or signed pending transaction identified through August 16, 2026.
